name: get_ticket
description: Look up one helpdesk ticket by its id, e.g. TKT-0004. Returns subject, priority, status and the employee id.

name: get_user
description: Look up one employee by id, e.g. EMP-1001. Returns name, department, location and whether the person is a VIP.

name: reset_password
description: Reset an employee's password. This CHANGES data. (Mock: nothing is really reset.)
